_meta.description: Family (focus-area) assignment for every Metal-path node. Families drive the map's regions and the progress panel; they are presentation + analytics metadata and never affect the engines. Structure: Foundations feed everything; Fretboard & Theory is the shared spine (not a path); Rhythm and Lead are true specializations. INVARIANT (loader-tested): no node in one specialization may directly require a node in the other — shared needs live in the spine. Judgment calls: pinch harmonics in Rhythm (squeals are riff accents), tremolo in Rhythm (black-metal riffing), the arpeggio/sweep chain (incl. dim7) in Lead, fast alternate picking in Lead (Andres 2026-07-19: rhythm alternate is easy on its own; 3nps crossings and skips are the real skill - thrash speed is downpicking's job), octave shapes in Theory (fretboard-mapping tool).
